messages:
Linda (CS): FYI - onboarding issue: some new tenants getting 401 during webhook validation after last night's deploy. Im seeing spikes in tickets and one upcoming renewal looks at risk. Need a short customer update and outreach plan.
ops-bot: deploy-rollback: rollback started at 2026-03-21T14:12Z by @tom-eng.
Tom (Eng): Confirmed cause: stricter header validation rejected proxied webhook requests from some CDNs. Rolled back; rolling a hotfix in progressive deploy (ETA ~90m). Can provide per-tenant toggle if needed.
Maria (CS): Please export affected tenant list + tiers. I'll segment: Enterprise = 1:1 + credit; SMB = templated email + FAQ. Flag renewals <60 days.
Kevin (Support): I have 6 matching tickets. I'll attach ticket links to the CSV and open dedicated threads for enterprise. Recommend SLA credit for onboarding blocked >24h.
Jess (Onboarding): I'll host two office hours (today 17:00 PT, tomorrow 09:00 PT) and prepare a one-page checklist and quick survey for feedback.
Linda (CS): Draft customer note to personalize:

"Hi <CustomerName> - were sorry for the onboarding interruption. A recent deploy caused intermittent webhook authentication failures. We've rolled back the change and are restoring normal onboarding. We'll follow up when your tenant is validated. If you were impacted, were offering a one-time credit and a prioritized assist session. Office hours sign-up: <link>. Reply to request a 1:1. - Linda & CS"

Maria (CS): I'll add renewal reassurance copy for enterprise and include credit suggestions for finance (SMB $50, Growth $250, Enterprise case-by-case).
Tom (Eng): Hotfix rolling out now. Will post status in #eng-runtime and update this thread when error rates normalize.
Kevin (Support): Tickets updated. CSMs CCed. KB draft: "If webhook returns 401 during onboarding" in progress.
Tom (Eng): Rollout done 2026-03-21T17:29Z; telemetry shows handshake success back to baseline. Final RCA will be shared in ~2 business days.
Linda (CS): Thanks. Maria - please send segmented outreach once CSV is ready. Jess - paste top feedback points here after office hours. Closing thread after outreach batch completes. :white_check_mark:
